note: Budget for `node scripts/package-size.mjs --check` (CI, P8): the cost, minified + gzip, of an app built from each fixture in fixtures/packages, TanStack included, minus the empty app. `measuredGzipBytes` is the value when the budget was last set; `maxGzipBytes` is that plus 5%, capped at `ceilingGzipBytes`, the SPEC-v3 ceiling from spike/REPORT.md. A budget above its ceiling fails the check: that is a design question for the maintainer, not a budget raise. Raise a budget only on purpose, in the same change that adds the weight.
history: 3.0.0-next.0 (PR-B): first measurement. The core fixture has five stock features (sorting, pagination, column filtering, global filtering, row selection; no sizing, D10) and both plugins. Its +5% (18344 B) is over the 17500 B ceiling, so the budget is the ceiling: 30 B of room.
